claim: In the matching retail DLL, FormAnimator.StartAnm (MethodDef 0x06004E75) is an instance void method with one Int32 parameter named anm_idx. Its 328-byte body stores arg1 into CurrentAnmIdx; stores 0 into reqAnmInit, 1 into isAnmBoot, and -1 into currentFormIdx; stores plObj.PlIdx into AnmHostPlayer; copies CurrentSkill.anmType into anmType; copies CurrentSkill.anmData[CurrentAnmIdx].terrainColType into plObj.TerrainColType and .anmEndState into AnimeEnd; applies exact numeric ringKind/Zone/TerrainColType filtering; stores 1 into isIgnoreTerrainCol only when the resulting TerrainColType is nonzero; and then calls PreprocessEachAnm. In verified R6 raw capture bytes, all 5333 StartAnm PRE calls pair with POST calls. The recorder's direct traced parent is InitAnimation for 5288, StartSlotAnm_Immediately for 36, and absent for 9. The recorded POST AnmHostPlayer equals recorded owner_slot in 5333/5333 calls, including 244 calls where PRE AnmHostPlayer differed. In all 36 traced StartSlotAnm_Immediately -> StartAnm pairs, the parent's second raw argument equals the child StartAnm raw argument, matching the DLL StartSlotAnm_Immediately IL sequence ldarg.2; call StartAnm.
